name: sort by angle around a pivot, then pop any point that makes a non-left turn
mechanism: sort the points by angle about the lowest point, walk them in that order pushing onto a stack, and whenever the top two stack points and the new point fail to turn left, pop the top; what remains on the stack is the hull in order

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Graham scan' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry:

fails_when: collinear points need a tie rule
